name: smwgraphics-bs-super-ninja-kun-rocky-mine-exterior
title: BS Super Ninja-Kun - Rocky Mine (Exterior)
description:
A beautiful background seen in the first boss fight against the funny Skull Shogun antagonist, from BS Super Ninja-Kun. In the original game, the boss fight happens at high speed, while our hero, Ninja-kun rides a minecart. As expected from that, this background is perfect for parallax scrolling.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
